note: Branch film for rickyrampersadbranch.com/vid and /your-policy. Settles the client first, then what they already own, then the law as their right, then the agent. Agent-driven. No client names, no counts, no figures. Each scene names its visual; build-orphanfilm.py renders from this file; voice-lines.py voices and times it. Cut of 21 September 2026 after a judged rewrite.

scenes.headline:
Your representative
has moved on.
scenes.line: You hold a policy with Guardian Life. Your representative has moved on.

scenes.headline: Issued to you, by Guardian Life.
scenes.line: Guardian Life issued your policy to you, and Guardian Life holds it.
Your cover stays in force. Your premium is the one written in your policy. Your beneficiary is who you named.

rows.i: The same sum assured, from the day it was issued

rows.b: Your premium is the one written in the policy
rows.i: The figure in your schedule is the figure you pay

rows.b: Your beneficiary is who you named
rows.i: Where you are the life insured, it is paid to them, outside your estate

scenes.line: A note on your birthday. A reminder before a premium is due. A desk that answers the phone.

rows.b: A reminder before a premium is due

rows.i: A person. Every contact dated on your file

scenes.cap: is the price you still pay
scenes.line: Your premium is priced on the age you were when you started.

scenes.eyebrow: An honest mistake on the form
scenes.headline:
Three years in force,
and it is settled.
scenes.line: After three years, an honest mistake on the form cannot void it.

scenes.eyebrow: What may already be inside it
scenes.line: A benefit that pays your premiums if illness stops you working. A policy that has quietly matured. Money in one you thought had lapsed.

rows.i: If illness or injury stops you working, it pays your premiums for you
It reached the end of its term. The money is yours to claim
A policy that stopped does not always stop being worth something

scenes.headline:
A policy cannot
be moved.
scenes.line: A policy cannot be moved. It can only be ended, and another one started.

scenes.eyebrow: If a new one were bought
scenes.headline:
A new policy. Your age today.
Your health today.
scenes.line: A new policy is priced at your age and your health today.

scenes.headline: Already issued.
scenes.line: The one you hold is already issued. Nothing about your health now can touch it.

scenes.eyebrow: The Insurance Act · Trinidad and Tobago
scenes.quote: An agent, agency, broker, brokerage or a sales representative shall not … cause a policyholder to replace a long-term insurance policy without first discussing the advantages and disadvantages of the discontinuance of the policy.
scenes.ask: That is your right. Ask for both.
scenes.line: Before an agent or a broker may have your long term policy replaced, the advantages and the disadvantages of ending it must first be discussed with you.

scenes.eyebrow: Three things you may ask for
scenes.line: The advantages and the disadvantages. Enough information to decide. And a certificate of registration, from anyone advising you.

rows.i: Before any long-term policy is replaced
Any comparison fair, balanced, and leaving out nothing material
Anyone registered must produce it, or a copy, when you ask
